longTitle.officialTitle: To amend the Real ID Act of 2005 to permit Freely Associated States to meet identification requirements under such Act, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “REAL ID Act Modification for Freely Associated States Act”.

subsection.heading: Definition of State.—
subsection.content: Section 201(5) of the Real ID Act of 2005 (49 U.S.C. 30301 note; Public Law 109-13) is amended by striking “the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands,”.

subsection.heading: Evidence of Lawful Status.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 202(c)(2)(B) of the REAL ID Act of 2005 (49 U.S.C. 30301 note; Public Law 109-13) is amended—

paragraph.content: in clause (viii), by striking “or” at the end;
in clause (ix), by striking the period at the end and inserting “; or”; and

by adding at the end the following:
“(x) is a citizen of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, the Federated States of Micronesia, or the Republic of Palau who has been admitted to the United States as a nonimmigrant pursuant to a Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic or Federated States.” .
